idea.title: Texters who drive you mad
idea.summary: Five maddening texting habits, opened on 14 messages ending in 'nvm', ending on the viewer who replies in three days; a call has no nvm.
hookOptions: 14 messages in a row, then nvm
He replied k. with a full stop

scenes.text: Your friend sends 14 messages in a row, then types: nvm
scenes.say: Fourteen messages. Then nvm. We all know one.

scenes.title: texters who drive you mad

items.title: 14 texts, then 'nvm'
items.line: Fourteen pings in a row. The last one cancels all of them.

items.title: The 3-day reply
items.line: 'sorry just saw this!' They saw it on Monday.

items.title: Just 'k.'
items.line: With the full stop. Now you're checking what you did.

items.title: Voice note novelist
items.line: Four minutes long. Starts with 'okay so basically'.

items.title: You, reading this
items.line: You'll send this to them and reply 'haha' tomorrow.

scenes.cta: send this to your nvm friend
scenes.say: Nvm, after fourteen. Seen on Monday. Just k. Four-minute voice notes. And you, tomorrow.

scenes.ask: Which are you: nvm, k, or 3-day reply?
scenes.say: Calls don't need three days. randomtalker.com.

post.caption:
Which are you: nvm, k, or the 3-day reply? Send this to your nvm friend, then watch them reply in three days.
Or skip the typing and just talk to someone new: randomtalker.com
post.xText: Texters who drive you mad: the 'k.', the 3-day reply, 14 messages then 'nvm'. Send to yours. randomtalker.com
